sloka: महादेववचः श्रुत्वा काकुत्स्थः सहलक्ष्मणः ।विमानशिखरस्थस्य प्रणाममकरोत् पितुः ।। ६.१२२.९ ।।
transliteration: mahādevavacaḥ śrutvā kākutsthaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ ।vimānaśikharasthasya praṇāmamakarot pituḥ ।। 6.122.9 ।।

translations.english: Raghava along with Lakshmana offered salutations to his father seated on top of the aerial chariot after listening to Lord MahaDeva.
